bio: Beneath Tonio's unassuming exterior lies a mind of extraordinary calculation and patience. His decades among Venice's porters have taught him the value of invisibility—merchants and nobles speak freely in his presence, treating him as part of the scenery rather than a thinking man with ambitions. This learned invisibility has become his greatest asset; he absorbs valuable information daily while revealing nothing of his true financial position or ambitions.
